test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: How many key priorities are outlined in the Union Budget 2024-25 to achieve the objective of 'Viksit Bharat'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Union Budget 2024-25 has outlined **nine key priorities** aimed at achieving the objective of 'Viksit Bharat' or a developed India.
 
• These priorities are focused on various sectors such as infrastructure, digital economy, education, health, and agriculture.
 
• The objective of 'Viksit Bharat' is to ensure sustainable and inclusive growth, with a special emphasis on marginalized communities and sectors.
 
• The budget aims to enhance economic resilience and competitiveness while promoting social welfare and environmental sustainability.
 
• These priorities align with the long-term vision of making India a global economic powerhouse by 2047.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Infrastructure Development**

 
 
• Focus on enhancing transport, logistics, and urban infrastructure to improve connectivity and economic efficiency.
 
• Increased investment in railways, highways, ports, and airports.
 
• Promotion of green and sustainable infrastructure projects.
 
 
 
• **Digital Economy**
 
 
• Expansion of digital services and internet connectivity across rural and urban areas.
 
• Encouragement of startups and innovation through favorable policies and funding.
 
• Implementation of new technologies in government services to improve transparency and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Education and Skill Development**
 
 
• Enhancement of the education system to meet global standards.
 
• Focus on vocational training and skill development to prepare the workforce for future industries.
 
• Increase in budget allocation for research and development.
 
 
 
• **Health Sector**
 
 
• Strengthening of healthcare infrastructure and services, especially in rural areas.
 
• Promotion of preventive healthcare and wellness programs.
 
• Increased funding for public health initiatives and medical research.
 
 
 
• **Agriculture and Rural Development**
 
 
• Support for farmers through better access to credit, technology, and markets.
 
• Promotion of sustainable agricultural practices.
 
• Development of rural infrastructure to improve living standards and economic opportunities.
